item.title: Tekcapital shares jump as net assets nearly quadruple on data centre portfolio company valuation
item.summary: Tekcapital shares jumped on Thursday morning after the technology investment company announced record net assets and profitability driven by a newly formed company built around geothermal-powered data centre patents.
